name: voice-marker
description: Mark paragraphs with P(slop) and rewrite them in Dan's voice via a stylebot sidecar (ai-style/dan-style serve)

commands.title: Voice Marker: Rewrite in Dan's Voice
Voice Marker: Mark Selection as Content Edit (sem)

voiceMarker.command.markdownDescription: Sidecar command as argv, e.g. `["uv", "run", "--project", "/path/to/blog", "ai-style", "serve", "--detector-model", "_models/voice-clf"]`. Empty = extension stays dormant (set this per workspace, not globally).

voiceMarker.cwd.description: Working directory for the sidecar spawn (so relative --detector-model paths resolve). Empty = first workspace folder.

voiceMarker.thresholds.markdownDescription: Ascending P(slop) bucket edges; a paragraph below the first edge gets no mark. Calibrate to the detector's score distribution (quantiles), not equal-width bins. An array applies to every detector; an object keys edges by detector name (`{"voice-clf": [...], "sapling-20251027": [...]}`), and a detector without an entry marks nothing (`dan-style calibrate --detector …` cuts them).

voiceMarker.detector.markdownDescription: Which of the sidecar's armed detectors marks paragraphs (the `--detector` names it was started with). Empty = the sidecar's default, its first. *Voice Marker: Switch Detector* sets this.

enumDescriptions: Rescore after every edit, once the buffer is idle (debounceMs); also on open and on switching editors.
Rescore only when the document is saved.
Rescore only on the Rescore Document command (or Switch Detector / a rewrite).
voiceMarker.trigger.description: When text goes to the detector. A hosted detector spends per character sent, so prefer save or manual with one armed; unchanged paragraphs are answered from the sidecar's cache either way.

voiceMarker.minChars.description: Skip paragraphs shorter than this (short texts score noisily).

voiceMarker.debounceMs.description: Idle time after an edit before rescoring.

voiceMarker.bestOf.description: Candidates to sample per rewrite (the sidecar needs a styler armed — dan-style serve, or ai-style serve with --backend).

voiceMarker.timeouts.description: Per-op request budgets in ms, overriding the defaults (info 60000, segment 30000, score 30000, rewrite 180000, prefer 15000). A request that outruns its budget fails with an error instead of hanging the UI; two consecutive timeouts restart the presumed-wedged sidecar.
